title: Northbeam TechWorks Counter Statement: The Figure a Customer Settles
content:
When a customer asks to settle a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job at the desk, the figure they settle is the charges the settlement covers, plus the older charges standing unsettled that are due with them, less the relief already recognised on the job and less the money already held against those charges, and it is never below nothing.

## The four quantities

1. **The charges the settlement covers** are every charge standing on the job less the payments already received against it.
2. **The relief already recognised on the job.** No relief is recognised against those charges.
3. **The money already held against those charges.** No money is treated as already held against those charges.
4. **The older charges due with the settlement.** Nothing older is due with the settlement.

## Putting the four together

The charges the settlement covers and the older charges due with them are added; from that total the relief already recognised and the money already held are taken off; the outcome is rounded to the nearest cent; and where it would fall below nothing the figure settled is nothing.

A consumer profile settles the figure on the day it is worked out.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

A hypothetical job under TechWorks Standard Home Installation carries charges of 700.00 USD in all, against which payments of 250.00 USD have been received.

| Quantity | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Charges standing on the job | 700.00 |
| Payments already received against it | 250.00 |
| The charges the settlement covers | 450.00 |
| Older charges due with the settlement | 0.00 |
| Relief already recognised on the job | 0.00 |
| Money already held against those charges | 0.00 |

The figure settled is 450.00 plus 0.00, less 0.00 and less 0.00, which is 450.00 USD; rounded to the nearest cent it remains **450.00 USD**, and being above nothing it stands.

Where the same job carried 700.00 USD of charges against which 900.00 USD of payments had been received, the charges the settlement covers would fall below nothing, and the figure settled would be 0.00 USD.
